principle: The website is the frame. The cakes are the artwork.
rootCause: Gallery and shared SEO portfolio selectors retained an obsolete 600/760 fixed aspect ratio, object-fit contain, and lavender image background. Later overrides masked the issue but left a cascade regression risk.
sharedFix: .portfolio-cake-photo { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; max-width: none; background: transparent; }
